title: The Worker
description: The parts of the Worker: the entry that binds the page to the handler, the routes, GitHub sign-in, the sealed cookies and the read-only door to GitHub's API.

components.name: Entry
components.responsibility: index.js: imports the page's source text and exports createHandler(html) as the Worker's fetch handler.

components.name: Routes
components.responsibility: createHandler: serves the page at / and /index.html, sends /auth/* and /api/github/* to their handlers, and answers 404 to anything else.

components.name: GitHub sign-in
components.responsibility: start, callback, me and signOut: GitHub's OAuth code flow with PKCE, who is signed in, and signing out.

components.name: Sealed cookies
components.responsibility: seal, unseal, session and setCookie: values encrypted and authenticated with AES-GCM under a key derived from SESSION_SECRET, in HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookies.

components.name: GitHub door
components.responsibility: proxy and allowedPath: GET requests to the allowed GitHub API paths, with the session's token added and never returned.

components.name: The page
components.responsibility: index.html, the whole page, served as it is.

components.name: GitHub OAuth
components.responsibility: github.com/login/oauth: the authorize page the reader is sent to, and the code exchange.

components.name: GitHub API
components.responsibility: api.github.com: the signed-in account, its repositories, and repositories' trees and contents.

relationships.description: Seals the pending sign-in and the session, and reads them back.
Reads the session for its token; clears it when GitHub answers 401.
Sends the reader to authorize, and exchanges the code with the client secret and the PKCE verifier.
Looks up the account the token belongs to (GET /user).
Forwards the allowed reads, with the reader's token.
